title: Looking a value up by a key you only know at runtime
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: A bracket selector with a variable inside it reads the field whose name is the variable's value, not a field literally called `k`.

snippets.label: Looking a value up by a key you only know at runtime
